list.work: Astronomicon II, recensuit et enarravit A. E. Housman (1912)

normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt), held under text/ exactly as served, byte for byte: the file's SHA-256 in MANIFEST.sha256 is the hash of the served file, checked against the fetch log. It is held once (the form of EA-CORPORA-39). No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the scan's readings. The scans are held by reference at their Archive URLs.
scope: Book II (University of Toronto scan, catalogued by the Archive as 1903, the date of Book I; the title page reads MDCCCCXII).
why_seated: The method at its most exacting, in Housman's own edition. Book I (1903), whose preface is the manifesto, is not at the Archive and is pointed to.
held_out: Manilius I (1903), with the preface; 'The Application of Thought to Textual Criticism' (1921): not yet located in an open scan.
